description: Test suite for context visibility functions in the security module, covering evaluateSupplementalContextVisibility, shouldIncludeSupplementalContext, and filterSupplementalContextItems.

methods.name: evaluateSupplementalContextVisibility
methods.description: Evaluates whether supplemental context should be included based on mode, kind, and sender allowance.

methods.name: shouldIncludeSupplementalContext
methods.description: Determines if a specific supplemental context item should be included based on mode, kind, and sender allowance.

methods.name: filterSupplementalContextItems
methods.description: Filters a list of supplemental context items, excluding blocked ones and counting omitted items.
